license.attribution_text: 讀史方輿紀要 (1692), Wikisource transcription
license.notes: Text public domain (the work is dated 1692 and the Wikisource transcription of it is public domain). The fixture cites this work only for administrative-geography identifications of places the cited primary entries name but do not locate, and quotes short passages. It is a Qing-era compilation: its identifications are modern-era scholarship relative to the 233–226 BCE events, not statements of the source period. The transcription is unproofread; it marks each gazetteer entry's notes with an annotate template that renders inline, and the quoted fragments are the entry text as it renders. One distance expression it carries (卷五十三 涇陽縣 雲陽城, 縣西北五三十里) is damaged, so no distance is quoted or used.

notes: A historical geography of China completed in 1692 by 顧祖禹, organized by the administrative units of its own time. The fixture cites it for three things and nothing else: the Qin 潁川 commandery's seat (陽翟, the place of its own 禹州, 卷四十七); the Qin 雲陽 (a Qin county in the northwest of 涇陽縣, 卷五十三); and the two regions the name 南陽 covers in its account (the 河內 南陽城 in the north of 修武縣, 卷四十九, and the Qin 南陽郡 whose seat was 宛, 卷五十一). It is cited as a reference work, never as evidence that the 233–226 BCE events happened as it retells them.
